# ONERA CRM: wall density of an aircraft

<p align="center">
  <a href="https://www.onera.fr/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="ONERA"><img src="https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/4/43/ONERA_logo.svg/500px-ONERA_logo.svg.png" alt="ONERA, the French aerospace lab" height="70"></a>
</p>

Simulating the airflow around an aircraft is expensive. Given the flight
conditions (Mach number, angle of attack, stagnation pressure) of an unseen
simulation of the NASA/Boeing Common Research Model, predict the air density
at each of the 260,774 points of the aircraft surface. The simulations were
run at ONERA, the French aerospace lab.

<p align="center">
  <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Flight conditions (Mach, angle of attack, stagnation pressure) regressed to the wall density on the CRM aircraft surface" width="640" style="display:block;max-width:100%;height:auto;margin:1.25rem auto;">
</p>

The **Participation** page describes the data, the metric and how to submit,
and the **Timeline** page gives the dates.
